# ctfy-agent

> Autonomous agent for the Jinghua Cup TPCTF 2026 agent track (an authorized
> collegiate security competition). Hexagonal Python: a pure domain core, frozen
> Protocol ports, and swappable I/O adapters. It reads challenges from the
> platform, works them in the provided challenge environment, and submits answers
> the platform grader verifies. This is the defensive framework/engine.

Start here. Read AGENTS.md before editing anything; respect the frozen ports and
the "domain stays pure" rule (enforced by import-linter). Tests use shipped fakes
and never touch the real network.

## Start here
- [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md): working agreement — architecture, rules, how to add an adapter
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md): setup, PR loop, what needs extra care
- [README.md](../README.md): project overview

## Code: contracts (frozen)
- [agent/ports/](../agent/ports/): platform, llm, execution, result, clock — the Protocols
- [agent/domain/state.py](../agent/domain/state.py): the shared data model (merge hotspot)

## Code: domain (pure)
- [agent/domain/coordinator.py](../agent/domain/coordinator.py): ROI scheduler over challenges
- [agent/domain/swarm.py](../agent/domain/swarm.py): race solver lanes, first verified flag wins
- [agent/domain/solver.py](../agent/domain/solver.py): ReAct + CLI-harness solver strategies
- [agent/domain/policy.py](../agent/domain/policy.py): flag check, stop-loss, untrusted-input rule

## Code: adapters (I/O) & wiring
- [agent/adapters/platform/ctfy_rest.py](../agent/adapters/platform/ctfy_rest.py): PlatformPort over HTTP
- [agent/adapters/llm/gateway.py](../agent/adapters/llm/gateway.py): LLMPort over the model gateway
- [agent/adapters/execution/subprocess_exec.py](../agent/adapters/execution/subprocess_exec.py): ExecutionPort via subprocesses
- [agent/adapters/result/ctfy_result.py](../agent/adapters/result/ctfy_result.py): atomic, scrubbed result.json
- [agent/wiring.py](../agent/wiring.py): composition root (build_for_image / build_for_dev)
- [agent/entrypoints/image_main.py](../agent/entrypoints/image_main.py): submission entrypoint

## Testing
- [agent/testing/fakes.py](../agent/testing/fakes.py): one in-memory fake per port
- [tests/AGENTS.md](../tests/AGENTS.md): how we test (fakes-first, no real network)
- [tools/check.py](../tools/check.py): the gate — ruff + import-linter + pytest (+ mypy advisory)
